title: 第17章  兽象气第18章  脱落者
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
铁爪狼，凶残的F级妖兽，对人形生物具有强烈攻击性。
麻烦的是成群出动，每个狼群至少有百只铁爪狼，不是他们能处理的。
“铁爪狼群狡诈多端，正常不敢进入猛兽岭区域的，这象群也是知道这点，才跑到这里逃生。”
傅佳佳看出了他的担心，在一旁小声道。
“干吧，来都来了。”铁牛把盾牌切换成战锤形态，跃跃欲试。
“那就干，现在分配任务。”
“佳佳主攻，飞刀放血。”
“铁牛策应，有落单虚弱的直接锤上去。”
“我在八百米开外，为你们掩护阻击！”
分配完任务后，三人各就各位。
傅佳佳率先出击，黑夜里白光一闪，几柄柳叶飞刀，瞬在一头小象身上划出数道血痕。
突然的攻击，引发了象群的骚乱。
有钢鬃象察觉到傅佳佳在丛林跃动的身影，嘶吼一声，鬃毛高高竖起，而后万针齐发，往她那处射去。
傅佳佳双腿在高树丛林间踏走如飞，利用树干藤蔓，挡去了大半鬃毛钢针。
少量钢针落到她身上，她也只是抬臂抱头，利用身上的战斗服将之接了下来。
看傅佳佳这边问题不大，苏青转而将眸光放到铁牛身上。
因傅佳佳引发的骚乱，原本就经历狼群追击，惊魂未定的象群，立刻惊慌失措，在树林里横冲直撞，散了阵形。
趁此机会，铁牛抡锤便上。
对他而言，钢鬃象的鬃毛钢针，根本就破不了他的铁布衫防御。
每有钢针射来，都会被萦绕在他身前的血气所削弱，再落到他铜铸铁皮身上，伤害几乎跟蚊虫叮咬差不多。

他脚踏实地，硬扛着鬃毛钢针，拦在象群前方，不断躲闪着象群那如柱般的大腿。
实在躲不过去的，就切换棍形态，抱棍运功硬挺，虽然有些难受，但人棍也能把象脚戳出一个血洞。
再见到其他没落到身上的象脚，就猛运全力轰下一锤。
按苏青的要求，这钢鬃象他想要活的。
杨铁牛也完全听他吩咐，将一头头钢鬃象腿脚砸烂，倒在地上。
他的问题可能就只是速度较慢。
在象群四处奔逃时，只来得及砸倒三四头象，象群眼看就要跑远了。
这时候，就需要跟傅佳佳跟他出手了。
傅佳佳追着象群不断射出飞刀，让它们流血虚弱，可以被铁牛慢慢追上。
而苏青则在象群前方不断射出灵能枪。
蓝色灵能波，划出一道道子弹轨迹，每一发都能在钢鬃象身上崩出硕大血洞。
“百发百中！”
他赞了自己一声。
不管目标大不大，就说是不是弹无虚发吧！
心情愉悦，也跟战况有关。
原本以为象均F级战力的钢鬃象，能给他们带来些麻烦。
没想到，傅佳佳身法俊，飞刀准，临战反应也在他预料之上。
“武院考核安排的那铁甲战士，对这姑娘不利啊，以她身手，换一种考核方式，她极有可能靠自己本事考入天一武院的！”
对傅佳佳能力表示认可的同时。
他也明白此战最大的功臣是杨铁牛。

他都没想到铁布衫大成之后，正面攻坚能力会如此出色。
那钢鬃象的践踏之力，怕有万斤之重，即使这样，铁牛也都能顶得住。
“很难想象，去到那武道圣胎，将这门武学习至圆满后，铁牛的抗压扛打能力有多出色！”
他有些憧憬的道了一声，小心翼翼的接近主战场。
content_en:
The Iron Claw Wolf is a ferocious F-level monster that is highly aggressive towards humanoid creatures.
The trouble is that they go out in groups, and each pack has at least a hundred iron-clawed wolves, which they can't handle.
"The Iron Claw wolves are so cunning that they would normally not dare to enter the Beast Ridge area. This elephant group also knew this, so they ran here to escape."
Fu Jiajia noticed his worry and whispered from the side.
"Let's do it, it's here." Tieniu switched the shield to the hammer form, eager to try.
"That's it, let's assign tasks now."
"Jiajia's main attack is to use flying knives to bleed."
"Tie Niu will provide support, and those who are left alone and weak will be hammered directly."
"I'm eight hundred meters away, covering for you!"
After assigning tasks, the three of them took their places.
Fu Jiajia was the first to attack. There was a flash of white light in the dark night, and several willow leaf flying knives instantly drew several blood marks on a baby elephant.
The sudden attack caused a commotion among the elephants.
A steel-maned elephant noticed Fu Jiajia's leaping figure in the jungle, roared, raised its mane high, and then fired thousands of needles at her.
Fu Jiajia's legs flew through the tall trees and jungle, using tree trunks and vines to block most of the mane steel needles.
A small number of steel needles fell on her body, but she just raised her arms to cover her head and used her combat uniform to catch them.
Seeing that there was no big problem on Fu Jiajia's side, Su Qing turned to Tieniu.
Due to the commotion caused by Fu Jiajia, the frightened elephant herd, which had been chased by wolves, immediately panicked, ran rampant in the woods, and broke up.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Tieniu Hammer came forward.
As far as he is concerned, the steel needles of the steel-maned elephant cannot break the defense of his iron shirt at all.
Every time a steel needle was shot, it would be weakened by the blood energy lingering in front of him. When it fell on his copper-cast iron body, the damage was almost like a mosquito bite.
He was down-to-earth, carrying the steel needle with mane, blocking the front of the elephants, constantly dodging the pillar-like thighs of the elephants.
If you really can't dodge, you can switch to the stick form and hold the stick to move forward. Although it is a bit uncomfortable, the human stick can also poke a bloody hole in the elephant's foot.
When he sees another elephant's foot that has not fallen on him, he will hit it with all his strength.
According to Su Qing's request, this steel mane looks like what he wants to live for.
Yang Tieniu also obeyed his orders completely, smashing the legs and feet of the steel-maned elephants and falling to the ground.
His problem may just be slow speed.
When the elephants were running around, they only had time to knock down three or four elephants, and the elephants were about to run away.
At this time, it was necessary to take action with Fu Jiajia and him.
Fu Jiajia chases the elephants and continuously shoots flying knives, causing them to bleed and weaken, so that the iron bull can slowly catch up with them.
Su Qing, on the other hand, kept firing psychic guns in front of the elephant herd.
The blue psychic waves drew bullet trajectories, and each shot could create a huge blood hole in the steel-maned elephant's body.
"A perfect shot!"
He praised himself.
Regardless of whether the target is big or not, let’s just say it’s a perfect shot!
A happy mood is also related to the battle situation.
They originally thought that the steel-maned elephant, which had an F-level combat power, could cause them some trouble.
Unexpectedly, Fu Jiajia's body and skills were good, her flying knife was accurate, and her reaction in battle was beyond his expectations.
"The armored warrior arranged by the martial arts academy for the assessment is not good for this girl. With her skills and another assessment method, she is very likely to be admitted to the Tianyi Martial Arts Academy on her own!"
While expressing recognition of Fu Jiajia's ability.
He also understood that the biggest contributor to this battle was Yang Tieniu.
He didn't expect that after the iron cloth shirt was completed, his frontal attack ability would be so good.
The trampling force of the steel-maned elephant may weigh ten thousand kilograms, but even so, the iron ox can withstand it.
"It's hard to imagine how outstanding Tieniu's ability to withstand pressure and fights will be after he went to that martial arts holy fetus and learned this martial art to perfection!"
He said with some longing and cautiously approached the main battlefield.
